lines.t: Through the valley where shadows fall, I hear His voice, a gentle call.
No fear, no doubt, He leads my way.
Every step His hand is near
Through the storm I feel no fear
Yahushua is my shepherd, my guide
In His arms I will abide
He walks with me
He sets me free
Yahushua is all I need
Fields of grace stretch far and wide
Living waters where I reside
He lifts my soul, He fills my cup
Every tear He wipes away
Through the night He brings the day
Yahushua is my shepherd, my guide
In His arms I will abide
He walks with me
He sets me free
Yeah, who's sure is all I need
Oh-oh-oh-oh-oh
